non_regression.rule: Preserve config6 substantive open-source role, CLEAN semantic isolation, exact tested-scope/provenance, read-only connector discovery/write boundary, checkpoint/resume, failure recovery and base continuation. Config7 changes only per-invocation lifecycle slicing so recurring anti-stop survives the observed scheduled-Chat invocation boundary.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: Open-ended across recurring invocations; checkpoints/findings are never global completion. Execute one highest-value bounded substantive Phase-1 open-source slice, persist/read back role-local checkpoint/output and exact continuation, then return recurring-open when frontier remains instead of intentionally running to a hard runtime boundary.
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts
policy.control_freshness: obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that SHA; repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and refetch on changed control/config revision; freeze selected config after semantic start; quarantine/discard excess connector semantic payload.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve useful recurring execution under the observed scheduled-Chat long-invocation stop boundary without weakening CLEAN scope or anti-stop.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.evidence_basis: failure_evidence config6 produced role-valid durable progress and stayed enabled in the short-return band while untreated evaluation/evidence_comparator/bridge and open_source again stopped in the roughly one-minute band. This is operational method evidence, not Phase-1 acceptance evidence.
per_invocation_method: Choose the highest-value currently executable Phase-1 leaf within this CLEAN role's sanitized assignment.
Prefer one bounded unit that yields one source-qualified finding, primary-source verification, reproducible public artifact, or concrete blocker diagnosis plus exact continuation.
Persist/read back role-local checkpoint/output and immutable own receipt before starting another optional unit.
If material frontier remains after the durable slice, return recurring-open; next recurrence resumes exact continuation without duplicating completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker evidence and alternative-route continuation, then return recurring-open; unavailable capability remains unresolved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If bounded slicing reduces role-valid useful-output rate or prevents scientific continuation without improving physical persistence, increment config again and adjust slice granularity; never restore deliberate run-until-hard-stop behavior as anti-stop semantics.

policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Discover connector/tool/schema capability only through non-mutating schema/list/discovery and read-only lookup. Never create, update, delete, move, or otherwise mutate a branch, ref, file, pull request, issue, release, workflow, external resource, or account state as a noop/test/probe. A connector mutation is allowed only when required by substantive open_source work and confined to the authorized open_source role-local state/output or immutable own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.repository_write_boundary: Authorized writes are confined to research_workers_clean_g1/open_source/ role-local state/output pointers and automation_control/receipts/open_source/ immutable receipts. Temporary/noop branches or refs, probe PRs/issues/releases/workflows, and mutations outside those destinations are forbidden.

migration.reason: Matched runtime evidence discriminated the lifecycle hypothesis: treated failure_evidence config6 stayed enabled with role-valid durable progress while untreated roughly one-minute roles stopped again, and open_source newly joined that stop cohort. Config7 applies only the bounded-slice lifecycle method.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if config7 weakens CLEAN isolation, tested-scope/provenance, connector/write safety, continuation/recovery semantics, or demonstrably harms valid progress/persistence. Repair by incrementing again; do not restore intentional run-until-hard-boundary behavior.
